## The problem

Three binds on one row. (a) The registry carried no machine-readable
redistribution lane — `sources.toml` had rights records but no
`lane`/`evidence`/`decision_authority`/`part_viii_class` fields the
rest of the pipeline could consume, so the interim rights-record
basis was the only lane signal and `public` could never be evidenced
(`D-P35.31-1`). (b) The DB mirror, view and export artifacts the J3
design names (`source_redistribution`, `v_transparency_source`,
`sources.json`/`counts.json`) did not exist — lane and Part VIII
fields had nowhere to flow. (c) K9 C-6's two "last change" columns
needed the intended semantics (upstream-declared else records digest
for *upstream* change; the per-source slice-hash for *SIG's records*).

## What ships

- **`[redistribution]` for all 588 registered sources** —
  `connectors/data/sources.toml` gains a `[sources.<id>.redistribution]`
  block populated from `data/redistribution.csv` (the B-19 lane
  mapping): `lane` (`raw-ok`/`derived-only`/`link-only`/`restricted`/
  `unknown`), `evidence`, `evidence_uri`, `decision_authority`,
  `review_needed`, `part_viii_class`, `packet_limited`,
  `sig_labelled_cc0`. A source with no matrix row records an explicit
  `unknown` verdict with its honest evidence — never an invented lane.
  `connectors.registry.SourceRedistribution` parses with fail-closed
  validation: unknown keys, dangling fields, invented lanes/Part VIII
  classes, and a positive lane without evidence + authority all refuse;
  an **absent** block parses to `lane == ""` (honest undeclared) —
  distinct from a recorded `unknown`. `registry_version()` is a
  content-derived `sources.toml+<16 hex>` stamp.
- **Recorded lane through the resolver** — `sinks._registry_lane`
  returns the recorded declaration (`lane_basis:
  registry:[redistribution]`) plus every field the mirror needs;
  undeclared blocks fall back to the interim rights-record basis whose
  basis string stays `interim:*`. Registry metadata never becomes an
  ingestion permission.
- **Lane × Part VIII tier derivation** — `PgClaimSink._lane_and_custody`
  prefers the recorded lane and calls
  `derive_storage_tier(lane, part_viii_class)`: `raw-ok` + `clear`/
  `none-known` → `public` (now reachable — `D-P35.31-1` closes),
  `raw-ok` + a non-sealed P8 class → `restricted`, `derived-only`/
  `link-only` → `restricted`, `restricted`/`unknown`/absent lane or
  `P8-1`/`P8-2`/`P8-4` → `sealed`. `public` is never a default.
- **Append-only DB mirror + export view** — new sqitch change
  `transparency_source` (deploy/revert/verify + plan append): the
  `source_redistribution` mirror keyed `(source_id, registry_version)`
  with closed-vocab CHECKs and an immutability trigger (a changed
  declaration lands a NEW row, never an UPDATE);
  `source_redistribution_current` renders the latest; the sink mirrors
  each resolved declaration `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` — +0 on re-run,
  nothing fabricated for undeclared sources. `v_transparency_source`
  joins registry ⋈ rights_record ⋈ latest decision ⋈ current
  redistribution ⋈ last-seen execution/capture — explicit columns
  only, every one on `TRANSPARENCY_SOURCE_VIEW_COLUMNS`, granted to
  `sig_export` only. `sig_read_public` joins the **current view**
  (publishable fields only — the API `capture()` served-tier floor
  needs it) and never the base table; the public-read allow-list test
  names it exactly.
- **Part VIII-aware served tier** — `PgReadStore.capture` left-joins
  the mirror (`to_regclass`-guarded: a pre-migration spine reads
  `NULL, NULL`, honest absence) and serves
  `served_storage_tier(recorded, lane, part_viii_class)` — the more
  restrictive of stored and derived, labelled `derived_at_read` when
  read-time tightening applies. A stored `public` survives only a
  recorded `raw-ok` + P8-clear pair; legacy constant-`public` rows
  tighten, never upgrade.
- **`transparency/sources.json` + `counts.json`** —
  `sig.transparency-sources/1` + `sig.source-counts/1` through the
  P35.31 scrub in `spine_export.py`: the lifecycle partition, lane +
  Part VIII fields, gated rows carrying the closed reason vocabulary
  (`terms`/`part_viii`/`not_reviewed`/`refused`/`gated`/
  `unknown_lane`), `no_upstream_url_recorded` where no URL is
  evidenced (S-6 — never invented), restricted/link-only surfaces as
  host + `path_sha256` (sealed emits nothing), the **K9 C-6 pair** —
  `last_upstream_change` (upstream-declared last-modified else the
  canonical records digest; byte-only drift does not move it) and
  `last_sig_records_change` (the release/slice-hash signal). Counts
  recompute deterministically from the emitted `sources.json` rows;
  a re-export is byte-stable.

## Honest absences (typed, never fabricated)

- `unknown` lane — a recorded verdict with its thin-evidence note,
  distinct from an absent block (the interim basis stays in charge);
  both derive `sealed`.
- `no_upstream_url_recorded` — the absence token where no URL is
  evidenced; restricted/link-only rows publish host + path hash;
  sealed publishes nothing at all.
- `review_needed` where the lane or evidence can't yet be evidenced —
  never a guessed lane.
- Mirror rows land only where the resolver carries a recorded
  declaration — undeclared sources write none.
- The view excludes the sensitive surface structurally: registry
  notes/contact/auth model/access method, reviewer identity beyond
  role, classified terms text, P8-1 payloads — a column absent by
  design, not scrubbed after the fact.
